reason: The unfired blanks need heat to become usable flooring, and the solar heating bay is the available furnace location.
expectation: The blanks will be fired into stronger floor material.

effect: The fired blocks can provide non-pressure paving for the growing bay.
reaction: The distinction between paving and pressure containment makes physical sense.
reason: The ceramic blocks are intended for paving, and the cleared growing bay needs a safe floor.
expectation: The blocks will form a floor for the pressure liner.

effect: The blocks provide a level floor, but their edges need padding before the liner can be installed.
reaction: The remaining padding requirement is clear and physically sensible.
reason: Insulation felt is a likely padding material for the hard block edges.
expectation: The felt will cushion the floor for the pressure liner.

effect: The felt needed a clean fabric cover first; the resulting underlay can now cushion the floor.
reaction: The automatic combination clarified the missing preparation.
reason: The padded underlay is made to protect the pressure skin from the ceramic floor.
expectation: The underlay will make the floor safe for the pressure liner.

effect: The floor is protected, so the pressure envelope can now be installed.
reaction: The layered floor preparation has a clear purpose.
reason: The folded pressure envelope belongs on the protected floor to create the room.
expectation: The envelope will be laid out on the protected floor, ready for inflation.

effect: The enclosure is sealed on the protected floor, with its airlock and service spine attached.
reaction: The separate roles of the seals and blocks are clear.
reason: The sealed room needs breathable gas to become inhabited.
expectation: The gas supply will pressurize the room for habitation.

effect: The room is pressurized and accessible; it still needs illumination.
reaction: The leak check makes entering the room feel earned.
reason: The grow-light rails are the available equipment for illuminating the pressurized growing room.
expectation: The rails will be installed to illuminate the room.

effect: The lights and connected service systems complete the inhabited growing room, and all chapter goals are finished.
reaction: The explanation that the original array was sized for the lights makes the final connection feel grounded.

mostWorthwhile.text: Preparing the floor and pressure envelope was worthwhile: the distinction between load-bearing blocks, protective padding, and an imported pressure seal made the construction physically understandable.

leastWorthwhile.text: The final lighting connection was straightforward and offered little decision-making, though it completed the room.

surprise.text: The felt could not be applied directly; it first needed a clean fabric cover to make the padded underlay. The compatibility feedback resolved that immediately.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt purposeless. The fabric-cover requirement was not obvious before the attempt, but its role in protecting the pressure skin was explained afterward.

continue.text: I would continue: the practical construction details made the room's progress satisfying, and I would be curious to see how it becomes a working growing space.
